name: wmkf_appreviewersuggestion-review-due-date-at-send
_comment: Additive reviewer reliability ledger field. Creation-only wave: this file deliberately does not attempt to extend wmkf_reviewstatus because schema-apply skips existing attributes. Provisioning is owner-gated and separate from code deployment.

attributes.description: The effective review due date rendered into the materials email, stamped once on the engagement row immediately after the first successful materials send. Re-sends never overwrite it.

The effective review due date rendered into the MOST RECENT materials email; overwritten on every successful materials send. Paired with wmkf_ReviewDueDateAtSend (set-once) so reliability scoring can ask either question: the deadline first committed to, or the deadline last communicated. Owner decision S369 — a set-once stamp alone marks a reviewer late when WMKF itself extended the deadline and re-sent, which is the same 'never penalize a reviewer for WMKF scheduling' principle behind withdrew-vs-released. Neither date is recoverable after the fact, so both are captured now.
